issue.description: tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection fails with 'tests/contract_manifest.txt is stale; run just refresh-contract-manifest'. Fix: run 'just refresh-contract-manifest' and commit the one-line manifest update. Triage labeled it FLAKY in ToolRun 9c299cefca56681b54ce3beac6555f82, but it reproduces deterministically in isolation on master 957513c8e1.
